omar: Cutting RC candidate v2026.3.1-rc. Artifact: gs://ci-artifacts/redwood/rcs/2026.3.1-rc.tar.gz sha256:abc123def456. Target promo window +2h. @maya @jess @linus please eyeball quick.

deploy-bot: pipeline #4821 finished. Image pinned: image:redwood/runner:2026.3.1-rc. Canary plan suggested: 5% -> 25% -> 100% (30m). Rollback playbook: /playbooks/releases/rollback.md

maya: starting quick smoke on staging now.

maya: smoke results: auth flows OK, embeddings OK. Reranker p50 120ms p95 420ms on a1-prod-sim (saw 3/50 requests @ ~680ms). attaching curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/rerank -d '{"q":"test"}'
```

jess: noted. I'll watch GPU pool mem and tail lat. If p95 > 500ms during canary we abort.

linus: included a small kv-cache fix in this RC (no DB schema changes). flipbook shows warm cache path exercised. should be low risk.

sheriff: oncall here; will be available for rollback call. +1

omar: decision point: hold or proceed? Proposal: proceed but enable fallback to quantized reranker model if latency >450ms in canary. Deploy config: model_fallback: reranker-v2-quant, health_check_latency_ms:450

deploy-bot: updated rollout policy for image:redwood/runner:2026.3.1-rc -> fallback model enabled. Canary health checks: 5m per stage, success rate >=95%, latency threshold 450ms, rollback triggers: error_rate +5% vs baseline OR median latency +200ms.

maya: retesting now (10m)

maya: retest green. reranker p95 360ms p99 480ms on canary sim. no functional regressions. :thumbsup: 

jess: infra metrics look good. GPU saturations low, no OOM. monitoring alerts quiet.

sheriff: oncall ack, ready for promo.

omar: signoff received from QA (maya), SRE (jess), Oncall (sheriff). Proceeding with promotion.

omar: @deploy-bot please promote image:redwood/runner:2026.3.1-rc to prod with canary id c-2255001234-1 and the configured fallback policy.

deploy-bot: promotion started. Canary id=c-2255001234-1. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/rcs/c-2255001234

deploy-bot: canary 5% complete. health=OK. advancing to 25%.

deploy-bot: canary 25% complete. health=OK. advancing to 100%.

deploy-bot: promotion complete. prod now running image:redwood/runner:2026.3.1. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026.3.1

omar: posting release notes to #releases and pinging product. Nice work everyone :tada:
